attchmntText: Gland Pharma Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: Gland Pharma filed the Q2 FY27 earnings call transcript with BSE and NSE on November 12, 2026. The call was held on November 06, 2026. Revenue for Q2 FY27 was INR 18,336 million, up 23% year-on-year. EBITDA rose 53% to INR 4,804 million. Profit after tax grew 58% to INR 2,908 million. CDMO revenues grew 31% to INR 8,227 million. Critical injectable revenues grew 18% to INR 10,109 million. US revenues grew 42% to INR 11,795 million. The company announced new leadership appointments. Mr. Deepak Sapra joins as CEO on November 16, 2026. Mr. Ajay Sahni joined as President of Cenexi operations. The company is initiating a brownfield expansion at Pashamylaram with an outlay of INR 10,000 million. Commercial operations are expected from FY2030. A greenfield project at Vizag SEZ is underway.

attchmntText: Gland Pharma Limited has informed the Exchange that Gland Pharma Limited ( Company ) has issued Corporate Guarantee on behalf of Phixen SAS, wholly owned step down subsidiary of the Company.
desc: Giving guarantees/indemnity/ becoming a surety for third party
voiceSummary: Gland Pharma Limited issued a corporate guarantee on behalf of its wholly owned step down subsidiary, Phixen SAS. The guarantee is provided to MUFG Bank Europe N.V. to secure a draw-down amount under a Uncommitted Revolving Facility Agreement. The facility is valued at Euro 50 Mn with an initial draw-down limit of Euro 18 Mn. Gland Pharma extended a corporate guarantee of EURO 20 Mn in favor of MUFG Bank. This guarantee secures the draw-down amount and interest thereon. The facility agreement is valid for 3 years. The corporate guarantee is valid until March 31, 2030. The company may extend the guarantee limit if draw-down limits for Phixen SAS increase in the future. The corporate guarantee is treated as a contingent liability for the company.

attchmntText: Gland Pharma Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of Mr Xiao Le as the Chief Investment Officer for Gland Pharma International Pte. Ltd (Wholly- owned subsidiary of Gland Pharma Limited), effective November 09, 2026
voiceSummary: Gland Pharma Limited has appointed Mr. Xiao Le as the Chief Investment Officer of its wholly-owned subsidiary, Gland Pharma International Pte. Ltd, effective November 09, 2026. Mr. Xiao Le will report to the CEO of Gland Singapore and is responsible for exploring investment opportunities and improving M&A capability in the United States of America, China, Singapore, and other countries. He holds over 15 years of experience in investment and asset management within medical devices, biopharma, and healthcare services. His background includes roles as Chief Financial Officer for MegaRobo Technologies, Director at CANbridge Pharmaceuticals, and Senior Director of M&A and Strategic Investments for Wuxi AppTec. Mr. Xiao Le holds a Bachelor’s degree in Bio-engineering from The Johns Hopkins University and a Master’s degree in Finance from The Massachusetts Institute of Technology. This disclosure is made pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.

attchmntText: Gland Pharma Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Gland Pharma Limited filed a notice regarding the publication of newspaper advertisements for its Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The advertisements were published in English and Telugu newspapers on November 07, 2026. The Board of Directors approved the Unaudited Financial Results, both Consolidated and Standalone, at its meeting held on November 06, 2026. The results, along with the Limited review reports by Statutory Auditors M/s. Deloitte Haskins & Sells, are available on the company website and the websites of BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited. The notice was signed by Company Secretary Sampath Kumar Pallerlamudi and Executive Chairman Srinivas Sadu, holding DIN number 06900659.
